lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Fe4O8 (BaFe2O4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Ba centers have eight O neighbors and O centers are three-coordinate to Fe. The Fe-centered octahedra share edges with one another, and Ba–Fe polyhedra show corner- and edge-sharing, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
